subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should maintainers publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook now, even though it includes node LaunchAgent disable instructions before runtime and doctor hardening ship?
rationale: The patch is documentation-only and no code defect remains, but the documented workaround mutates launchd-managed services and can affect hosts that intentionally rely on the node LaunchAgent.

options.title: Land The Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Accept the operator-risk tradeoff because the runbook is source-backed, warns remote-node users to skip the disable step, and gives affected users a recovery path while the runtime issue remains open.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Hardening
options.body: Wait until the generated wrapper and doctor/install behavior are fixed so public docs do not instruct manual launchd service mutation as the primary recovery.

options.title: Narrow To Diagnostics Only
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep symptom detection and links but remove or soften the bootout/rename steps until maintainers settle the node lifecycle policy.

recommendation.title: Land The Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Accept the operator-risk tradeoff because the runbook is source-backed, warns remote-node users to skip the disable step, and gives affected users a recovery path while the runtime issue remains open.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits at the intersection of macOS launchd lifecycle policy, service-env behavior, and public docs, where this history pass shows the strongest recent ownership signal.
